[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] '''Dazh Ranos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] active during the [[war against Zakuul]]. 

==Biography==
Throughout her time within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Dazh Ranos never felt like fitting in. From the very beginning, [[Gender/Legends|she]] disliked answering to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] had a critical view of the Council's actions, considering them stubborn and too traditional. Ranos believed their use of the same tactics in any fight ultimately led to their [[Eternal Empire conquest|loss]] against the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="Conversation" />

Despite warnings that her path could lead her to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Ranos broke ties with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and left [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to walk her own path and follow the will of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Dazh Ranos believed she would be better off on her own and set off for the far reaches of the known [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], away from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. She traveled the frontier and helped ordinary, everyday people with the intention of avoiding all the [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and bureaucracy.<ref name="Conversation" />

During and after the conflict with the Eternal Empire, Ranos had little contact with the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], for they considered her to be a rogue agent and an embarrassment. By the time the news of the war reached her at the edges of space, the Council had already gone into hiding. She openly revealed her indifference regarding the fate of the Council, uncaring whether they kept holding secret meetings or were all dead already. By now, she considered the [[Eternal Alliance]] a lot more important than the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] ever was. She believed that the [[Alliance Commander]]'s actions affected trillions of lives in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for better or for worse and that joining the Alliance would let her accomplish more than she ever could have done on her own.<ref name="Conversation" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sometimes I say things that rub people the wrong way.|Dazh Ranos|<ref name="Conversation" />}}
Ranos was a very outspoken and critical person which made her quite unpopular within the Jedi Order. She disliked [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] in the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython all day, and had no interest in the grand scheme of politics and bureaucracy, considering it more important to help the people who lived outside the Core Worlds. The Chiss considered herself quite independent and struggled with taking orders from anybody but herself. Master Ranos also believed that the dark side came from putting oneself before others and that true servants of the Force were automatically servants of the light. Dazh Ranos was also very proud of her skill with the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Conversation" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Think these lightsabers are just for show? Pretty good with them. Not bragging if it's true, right? I'm also smart enough to know when to use them. Seen too many "Masters" treat their lightsabers like a lumberjack with a new axe on Kashyyyk. Some problems can't be solved by chopping down everything in sight. No offense.|Dazh Ranos|<ref name="Conversation" />}}
Ranos wielded two metallic [[Crossguard lightsaber/Legends|vented Crossguard lightsabers]] powered by [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]].<ref name="Conversation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Ranos debuted in the [[2016]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]]. She was only available to players who achieved at least the "Eternal" tier during the "Dark vs. Light" event in summer 2016.<ref name="LvD">{{TORweb|url=blog/dark-vs.-light-event-and-rewards-blog|text=Dark vs. Light Event and Rewards Blog}}</ref> Ranos has since been made made unlockable for all players as part of Galactic Season 1, following the release of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|Update 6.3 "The Dark Descent"]].<ref name="Galactic Season">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210426-1|text=Galactic Season 1: The Stranger from Kubindi}}</ref>

If the player is playing as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', Ranos reveals that she also came across [[Kira Carsen]] during a guerrilla attack on a remote [[Zakuul]]ian outpost but that the rebels were captured and killed by [[Arcann]]. The whereabouts of Kira were unknown to Ranos but she remarked that Kira speaking highly of the [[Alliance Commander]] was partly the reason why Ranos joined the [[Eternal Alliance]]. Ranos also revealed information regarding [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] but deemed the entire story about him more a myth-enshrouded tale to teach morality.<ref name="Conversation" />
If the player is playing as [[Sith Warrior]], Ranos reveals information regarding [[Jaesa Willsaam]], depending whether Jaesa is affiliated with the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Conversation" />
